Goal! FC Thun 2, Heart of Midlothian 0. Brighton Labeau (FC Thun) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner following a fast break.
Nico Maier (FC Thun) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Furkan Dursun (FC Thun) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins FC Thun 2, Heart of Midlothian 0.
Substitution, Heart of Midlothian. Pierre Landry Kaboré replaces Sabri Guendouz.
